findings.title: Primitive construct_prism assumes vertical canonical orientation along Z axis
findings.details: The vertical slice primitive construct_prism places the triangular base on the XY plane and extrudes along Z. Arbitrary 3D orientation is not needed for P01-P08 canonical problems and remains out of scope.

findings.title: Prism contract adapter restricted to right-triangle-base right prisms
findings.details: Contract adapter validates right triangle base and perpendicular height specifically. General polygonal base prisms remain unsupported and fail closed safely as intended.

findings.title: Measurement evaluator test harness normalization
findings.details: Evaluation tooling was updated in previous wave to normalize Vietnamese token prefixes for length facts. Production adapter and FactGraph ingest relations deterministically.
